key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BFC6
name: allocate_buffers_and_wait
description: Allocates a memory block through an indirect library call and calls itself again if that allocation fails. Otherwise it fills several buffers, runs a ten-step copy loop, waits in a loop for a signal value, then clears state bytes and calls an indirect routine with two stored values.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C0A6
name: show_save_error_and_wait
description: Calls a library routine and stores its result, and when that result is non-zero it displays the referenced save-failure message. It then waits in a loop for a signal value, clears state bytes when a flag is zero, and calls an indirect routine with two stored values.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C0C6
name: show_load_error_and_wait
description: Displays the referenced load-failure message and then waits in a loop for a signal value. Afterwards it clears state bytes when a flag is zero and calls an indirect routine with two stored values.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C0F4
name: prompt_insert_game_disk_loop
description: Repeatedly displays the referenced request to insert the game disk and calls library routines until a non-zero signal value is returned. It then clears state bytes when a flag is zero and calls an indirect routine with two stored values.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C104
name: initialize_display_state
description: When a flag byte is zero it clears a byte and a word, calls several routines, sets a counter byte to 99 and calls routines with constants and global addresses. It finishes by calling an indirect routine with two values loaded from globals.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C214
name: call_library_and_check_result
description: Calls a library routine through an indirect pointer, or a direct routine when a flag byte is non-zero, passing a stored value and two parameters. If the returned word is negative it calls another routine and stores that routine's result in a global variable.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C238
name: call_library_store_word_result
description: Calls an indirect library routine with a stored value and two arguments taken from the caller frame, then stores the returned word. When that word is negative it calls another routine and stores the returned long in a global variable.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C262
name: write_bounds_to_table
description: Computes the address of a twelve-byte entry from the first argument and writes four words into it: the second argument minus 250, the third minus 200, the second plus 250 and the third plus 200.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C2BC
name: update_display_state
description: Calls several indirect display routines, increments a counter word, sets a few global bytes and words, and calls another routine with a constant argument. It finally adds three to each of six consecutive bytes in a table starting at index 16.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C3E4
name: run_scroll_window_animation
description: Calls indirect display routines, then for each step of a countdown from twenty-five down to minus twenty-nine copies a window of words from a table into a buffer and waits between steps. The referenced name winpic identifies the window picture it sets up.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C4A4
name: continue_scroll_window_animation
description: Continues the countdown-driven scroll loop from a counter already in progress, writing a window of words from a table, setting two offset words and waiting between steps. When the counter falls below minus twenty-nine it waits once more and copies the final window.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C4D0
name: scroll_window_with_random_offsets
description: Repeatedly reads two random values, shifts each left by eight bits and stores them as offset words. It then runs a countdown loop that copies windows of words from a table and waits between steps.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C560
name: return_conditional_size
description: Returns the constant eight, or ten when a byte read from a table at the argument plus a global offset is non-zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C572
name: select_and_dispatch_position_check
description: Selects an offset from a global flag, then masks a state value. When the masked value is zero or a global byte is greater than ninety-seven, it calls another routine with coordinates from global positions if a counter is below eight, otherwise with fixed values of one hundred, and returns that result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C586
name: dispatch_position_check_from_globals
description: Masks a state value and, when it is zero or a global byte is greater than ninety-seven, calls another routine with coordinates derived from global positions while a counter is below eight, otherwise with fixed values of one hundred. It returns the masked value or the callee's result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C5DA
name: call_routine_with_fixed_coordinates
description: Calls another routine with the constants one hundred, one hundred, one hundred and one, plus the address of a global pointer, then returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C5FC
name: dispatch_table_entry_action
description: Looks up a table entry from a value returned by an indirect call and stores an action code in it. It then branches on action codes one to ten: some codes call other routines with coordinates from globals, code eight compares an offset and sets a timer byte, and others set a flag or reset a timer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C61C
name: dispatch_action_from_registers
description: Looks up a table entry from an indirect call result and stores the action code held in a register. It then branches on that code: code eight compares an offset and sets a timer, codes one, three, five, two and six call other routines, and code four stores a masked value and resets a timer byte to twelve.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C64E
name: apply_action_code_state_updates
description: Handles action codes other than one: code eight compares an offset and sets a timer byte, code four resets a timer, code two sets a flag byte to four when a register matches a global value, and code ten resets a timer. Codes three, five and six perform no update here.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C680
name: dispatch_action_when_flagged
description: Handles action codes two through ten when a second register flag is non-zero: code eight compares an offset and sets a timer byte, codes two, three, five and six call other routines, and code four stores a masked value. Code ten calls another routine and resets a timer byte to twelve.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C72C
name: forward_to_nested_routine
description: Contains a single call to another routine with no arguments and then returns. The decompiled body performs no other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C74C
name: dispatch_flagged_actions_from_four
description: Branches on action codes four through ten, and performs its work only when a flag register is non-zero for codes other than four. Code four stores a masked value and sets a timer byte to twelve, code two sets a flag byte to four on a register match and calls routines with coordinates, and code ten calls another routine and sets the timer byte to twelve.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C770
name: dispatch_flagged_actions_from_three
description: Handles action codes three through ten when a flag register is non-zero, with code four storing a masked value and resetting a timer byte to twelve. Code three and five call another routine, code two sets a flag byte on a register match and calls routines with coordinates, and code six calls routines with coordinates.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C79E
name: dispatch_flagged_actions_from_five
description: Handles action codes five, two, six and ten, performing work only when a flag register is non-zero. Code two sets a flag byte on a register match and calls routines with coordinates, code six calls routines with coordinates, and code ten calls another routine and resets a timer byte to twelve.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C7CC
name: dispatch_flagged_actions_from_two
description: Handles action codes two, six and ten. Code two sets a flag byte when a register matches a global value and calls routines with coordinates when a flag register is non-zero, code six calls routines with coordinates, and code ten calls another routine and resets a timer byte to twelve.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C826
name: dispatch_flagged_six_or_ten
description: Handles action code six by calling routines with coordinates when a flag register is non-zero, and action code ten by calling another routine under the same condition before resetting a timer byte to twelve.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C83E
name: call_with_coordinates_if_flagged
description: When a flag register is non-zero it reads a value from a table, calls an indirect routine with the result and a constant, and calls another routine with no arguments. Otherwise it does nothing and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C882
name: handle_action_ten_timer
description: When a register equals ten it calls another routine if a second register is non-zero, then stores the byte twelve at offset sixteen of a structure.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C8B0
name: decrement_timer_and_trigger
description: Subtracts the argument from a global word counter. When the counter goes negative it resets it to zero and calls another routine with thirteen, otherwise it calls another routine with its own address as the argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C8D2
name: pass_own_address_onward
description: Calls another routine, passing that routine's own address as the argument, then returns. The referenced text is the short exclamation Yum with an exclamation mark, but this body does not display it directly.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C8E0
name: adjust_entry_and_store_positions
description: Decrements a word in a table entry selected by an index, then calls three indirect routines using a global value and a stored position. It stores the first returned word and the second returned word, which is offset by one hundred fifty, into two global variables.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C8E6
name: update_two_word_state
description: Calls three indirect routines, using a stored value and the result of the first call, then stores the two returned words into global variables. The second returned word is offset by one hundred fifty before storage.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:C95E
name: process_linked_record_list
description: Computes a base index from a word and the arguments, then calls an indirect routine with a constant to obtain a pointer and stores it. When that pointer is valid it walks a chain of records, calls routines for records whose fields match a global value, and loops over up to four positions adding a step, returning one on success and zero otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:CBF8
name: advance_counter_and_dispatch
description: Clears a flag byte in the input structure, adds a word from that structure to a 32-bit counter, and when the flag was zero calls four other routines. Returns a 64-bit value formed from the input register pair.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:CC24
name: interpret_byte_sequence_stream
description: Reads two-byte opcodes from a stream: opcode 129 loads a word from a table indexed by the low nibble, opcode 144 stores the second byte in a field, and opcode 255 with a zero operand ends the stream and sets a flag. Other opcodes with the high bit set end the loop, and plain bytes set a timer and copy values from table entries.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:CF40
name: decrement_counter_and_update_state
description: Writes the constant 256 to two word offsets of the first structure, then decrements a byte counter in the second structure when it is non-zero. When the counter reaches zero it writes two words to other offsets, and it finally sets the top bit of the word at offset 154 to flag the update.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:CF76
name: initialize_audio_and_dma
description: Stores two state bytes, then writes the audio channel one location, length, period and volume registers from the three parameters. It also writes constants that enable channel one's DMA and interrupt bits and sets a global word to a constant.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:CFCA
name: clear_audio_channel_flags
description: Clears the lowest bit of a flag byte at an offset from a global base, then writes zero to the audio period register and two to the audio volume register.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:CFF6
name: store_four_parameters
description: Stores the four input parameters to four distinct offsets relative to a global base and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D01C
name: initialize_audio_and_channel_state
description: Stores four parameters into globals, clears the four audio volume registers and several state fields, and copies four words from a table pointed to by a global into position fields. It sets four flag bytes to 255 and writes an audio DMA control value enabling four channels, then returns its input register unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D0D8
name: reset_audio_volumes_and_flags
description: Writes zero to four audio volume registers and writes fifteen to the DMA control register, which without its top bit disables the first four channels. It then sets a global flag byte to 255.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D0FE
name: setup_interrupt_handlers
description: Stores three parameters into global variables, sets up interrupt server structures with a constant priority and a flag, then calls two library routines to add an interrupt server and set an interrupt vector. It finally writes the constant 256 to the interrupt request and enable registers to clear one bit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D1A8
name: remove_interrupt_server_and_reset
description: Calls another routine, removes an interrupt server through a library call, and writes the constant 256 to an interrupt enable register. It then calls a library routine at a global base to set an interrupt vector.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D1D8
name: clear_memory_and_init_globals
description: Computes a derived address from a global index and stores it in a global. It then clears a block of 951 consecutive long words starting there, writes a register value and a global into two more globals, and calls another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D222
name: stub_return_immediately
description: A stub that does no work and returns straight away. It is an unreached gap in the executable and holds no meaningful behaviour.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D228
name: tokenize_text_into_argument_list
description: Opens a library through a library call and stops early when that fails. When a structure flag is clear it writes a fixed four-letter marker and calls library routines and a callback. Otherwise it splits a text string into words, honouring quoted sections, copies each word into a buffer, builds a table of pointers to the words and calls library routines with the results. The referenced text names the dos library.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D51A
name: copy_string_pad_zeros
description: Copies bytes from a source string into a destination up to a count or until a zero byte is found, then fills any remaining bytes of the count with zeros.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D53C
name: append_string_bounded
description: Scans to the end of the destination string, then appends bytes from the source up to a limit of 32766 bytes. If the limit is reached before the source ends, it writes a zero terminator after the last copied byte.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D542
name: append_string_with_count
description: Scans to the end of the destination string, then copies bytes from the source until a zero byte is copied or a counter from the third argument expires. If the counter expires first, it writes a zero terminator after the copied bytes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D566
name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination, including the zero terminator, and returns the original destination pointer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D576
name: multiply_32_bit_values
description: Multiplies two 32-bit register values using 16-bit halves and returns the low 32 bits of the product, with the second operand kept in the low word of the result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D59A
name: perform_signed_division
description: Determines the sign of the result from the signs of two register inputs and calls another routine. It negates that routine's result when the sign is negative, and returns it paired with the second input.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D5C2
name: negate_result_if_negative
description: Calls another routine, then negates the value it leaves in the second register when the first input is negative. Returns that value paired with the original second input.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D5DC
name: call_and_return_concatenated
description: Calls another routine and returns a 64-bit value formed from the original second register and the value the call leaves in that register.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D5E8
name: call_self_recursively
description: Calls itself with no other work and then returns, so the routine recurses without doing anything else.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D5F2
name: perform_32bit_division
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor held in registers. For divisors above sixteen bits it uses a shift and subtract loop, otherwise it uses 16-bit division, and returns the quotient and remainder together in a 64-bit result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D642
name: compute_string_length
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string from the given pointer until the terminator and returns the number of bytes before it. It does not modify memory.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D654
name: invoke_optional_callback_then_run
description: Calls a global function pointer if it is non-zero, then calls another routine with no arguments and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D672
name: clear_slots_and_dispatch
description: Calls a routine twenty times, then calls the global callback if one is set and dispatches stored pointers through other routines. It finally either calls routines with stored values or returns a value from another call.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D726
name: release_slot_entry_checked
description: Looks up one of twenty table entries from an index argument. When the index is out of range or the entry is empty it stores error code three and returns minus one, otherwise it calls a routine with the entry value when a flag bit is clear, clears the entry and returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D776
name: call_library_vector_36
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 36 from that base, passing the arguments through. It performs no other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D7B2
name: call_library_vector_132
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 132 from that base, passing the arguments through. It performs no other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D7CA
name: call_library_vector_84
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 84 from that base, passing the arguments through. It performs no other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D7DC
name: call_library_vector_30
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 30 from that base, passing the arguments through. It performs no other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D7EE
name: call_library_vector_60
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 60 from that base, passing the arguments through. It performs no other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D7F6
name: call_library_vector_42
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 42 from that base, passing the arguments through. It performs no other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D808
name: call_library_vector_66
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 66 from that base, passing the arguments through. It performs no other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D826
name: call_library_vector_90
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 90 from that base, passing the arguments through. It performs no other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D836
name: call_library_vector_48
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 48 from that base, passing the arguments through. It performs no other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D884
name: call_library_vector_414
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 414 from that base, passing the arguments through. It performs no other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D894
name: allocate_indexed_record
description: Asks a routine for a free index and returns zero when none is available. Otherwise it allocates a record through a library call, stores the first argument, a parameter byte and the index in it, sets a type byte to four and stores another library call result. It then calls a routine with the record or an inner field, and returns the record or zero if allocation failed.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D920
name: initialize_structure_and_call
description: Calls a routine to release the structure when a field is non-zero, then writes the constant 255 to a status byte and minus one to a long field. It calls another routine with a byte from the structure and finally calls an indirect library routine with the structure and the constant thirty-four.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D97E
name: forward_call_with_constant
description: Calls a function through a pointer taken from a global variable offset, passing the incoming argument and the constant forty-eight, then returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D994
name: forward_call_with_argument
description: Calls a function through a pointer taken from a global variable offset, passing the incoming argument unchanged, then returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:D9A6
name: allocate_typed_record
description: Returns zero when the first argument is zero. Otherwise it allocates a record through a library call with a memory flag, sets its type byte to five, stores the second argument in a word field and the first argument in a long field, and returns the record or zero if allocation failed.

name: parse_executable_hunk_records
description: Fills a load-state structure from tables of section values, then loops over record type words. It branches on values matching code, data and relocation record types and external references, storing offsets in fields and calling routines to advance or resolve each record.

key: star wars (1987)(domark)[cr df]/Star Wars (1987)(Domark)[cr DF].adf:l/Disk-Validator:0:0000
name: count_differing_bit_transitions
description: Clears a block of words to minus one and walks a range of bit positions taken from stored limits. At each position it extracts one bit from each of two word arrays and counts every place where the two bits differ, with nested loops calling routines through table offsets.

name: call_library_then_indirect_jump
description: Calls a library routine through a global base offset, then makes an indirect jump through a target table that could not be recovered and is therefore treated as a call. The referenced library call copies memory.

name: setup_disk_read_transfer
description: Pulses a CIA port bit with timed delays and then writes disk control words and a disk pointer to the hardware registers. When a stored value is found it clears a block of 849 long words and calls routines, otherwise it loops forever writing a constant register.

key: star wars (1987)(domark)[cr df]/Star Wars (1987)(Domark)[cr DF].adf:starwars:0:0006
name: forward_to_nested_routine
description: Contains a single call to another routine with no arguments and then returns. The decompiled body performs no other work.

key: star wars (1987)(domark)[cr df]/Star Wars (1987)(Domark)[cr DF].adf:starwars:0:0010
name: store_masked_field_if_flagged
description: If a type byte at offset four equals one and a flag bit at offset seven is set, stores the word at offset six masked to seven bits into the output word. It returns zero in every case.

key: star wars (1987)(domark)[cr df]/Star Wars (1987)(Domark)[cr DF].adf:starwars:0:0044
name: swap_buffers_and_set_bitplanes
description: When a pending flag is set it swaps two buffer pointers, clears the flag, decrements a counter and writes a scaled value into a table. It then writes four bitplane pointers spaced 8000 bytes apart, along with display window and data fetch registers and DMA control.

key: star wars (1987)(domark)[cr df]/Star Wars (1987)(Domark)[cr DF].adf:starwars:0:0112
name: decode_joystick_movement_deltas
description: Sets a status byte to 255, then either decodes direction bits from a 16-bit counter word into movement deltas of minus five, five, minus seven or seven, or computes deltas from stored values when a flag is set. The deltas are stored in position words.

key: star wars (1987)(domark)[cr df]/Star Wars (1987)(Domark)[cr DF].adf:starwars:0:011A
name: track_fire_button_and_deltas
description: Tracks a fire-button bit read from a global input byte, setting or clearing a state byte and resetting a stored word to minus one when the button is released. It then decodes direction bits from a counter word into movement deltas, as the joystick routine does.

key: star wars (1987)(domark)[cr df]/Star Wars (1987)(Domark)[cr DF].adf:starwars:0:013E
name: decode_joystick_movement_deltas
description: Sets a status byte to 255, then either decodes direction bits from a 16-bit counter word into movement deltas of minus five, five, minus seven or seven, or computes deltas from stored values when a flag is set. The deltas are stored in position words.

key: star wars (1987)(domark)[cr df]/Star Wars (1987)(Domark)[cr DF].adf:starwars:0:0180
name: apply_joystick_deltas_with_clamp
description: Decodes direction bits from a 16-bit word into deltas, adds them to stored horizontal and vertical positions, and clamps horizontal values to 0 to 319 and vertical values to 0 to 199.

key: star wars (1987)(domark)[cr df]/Star Wars (1987)(Domark)[cr DF].adf:starwars:0:0192
name: apply_direction_deltas_with_clamp
description: Decodes direction bits from a register word into deltas, adds them to stored horizontal and vertical positions, and clamps the results to 0 to 319 horizontally and 0 to 199 vertically.

key: star wars (1987)(domark)[cr df]/Star Wars (1987)(Domark)[cr DF].adf:starwars:0:01AA
name: advance_position_with_timed_trigger
description: Adds direction deltas to stored horizontal and vertical positions and clamps them to the screen. When a countdown word reaches one it resets that word, copies stored values into an object structure, runs a delay loop of 100 steps and sets a flag word with its top bit set.

key: star wars (1987)(domark)[cr df]/Star Wars (1987)(Domark)[cr DF].adf:starwars:0:01D2
name: clamp_positions_and_countdown
description: Clamps stored horizontal and vertical positions to their screen ranges, then when a countdown word reaches one it resets that word and copies stored values into an object structure.

key: star wars (1987)(domark)[cr df]/Star Wars (1987)(Domark)[cr DF].adf:starwars:0:01EC
name: start_timed_copy_on_countdown
description: Clamps the vertical position to a minimum of zero, then when a countdown word reaches one it copies stored values into an object structure, sets a flag word with its top bit set and runs a delay loop of 100 steps.

key: star wars (1987)(domark)[cr df]/Star Wars (1987)(Domark)[cr DF].adf:starwars:0:0204
name: countdown_copy_set_background
description: When a countdown word reaches one it copies stored values into an object structure, runs a delay loop of 100 steps and writes a stored value to the background colour register. Further code updates related state fields.

key: star wars (1987)(domark)[cr df]/Star Wars (1987)(Domark)[cr DF].adf:starwars:0:0374
name: take_pending_value_and_clear
description: Returns a stored word and resets it to zero when it is non-zero, so each pending value is consumed once.

key: star wars (1987)(domark)[cr df]/Star Wars (1987)(Domark)[cr DF].adf:starwars:0:0390
name: exchange_marker_message_with_port
description: Waits on a port or signal through a library call, and when that call returns a non-zero handle it stores a fixed marker value in a message, passes it through a library routine and releases it through a second library call. It returns a word taken from the message.

key: star wars (1987)(domark)[cr df]/Star Wars (1987)(Domark)[cr DF].adf:starwars:0:03B2
name: send_marker_message_and_free
description: Stores a fixed marker value in a message structure, passes the message through a library routine and then releases it through a second library call. It returns a word taken from the structure.
